change_request.title: Added scan support for indexed fieldTypes
change_request.author: vinaykpud

task.task: Add end-to-end analytics-engine scan support for indexed field types, including IP and binary predicates and project expressions on the DataFusion backend.
subtasks: Extend schema mappings: map ip/binary to VARBINARY, unsigned_long/scaled_float to BIGINT, float/half_float to REAL, match_only_text to VARCHAR, and date_nanos to TIMESTAMP. Reject unsupported types with an informative IllegalArgumentException and register the additional supported backend field types.

Normalize inferred Arrow schemas before DataFusion table registration across query, indexed-query, session-context, and SQL-to-Substrait paths: convert BinaryView to Binary, UInt64 to Int64, and Float16 to Float32, including nested types while preserving metadata and nullability. Leave compatible schemas unchanged and document conversion limitations.

Register the BINARY placeholder scalar function and implement a DataFusion adapter that converts VARCHAR literals into storage-compatible bytes: 16-byte IPv6-mapped IP encoding or base64-decoded binary. Reject invalid values and wrap generated literals in a nullable VARBINARY abstract cast to preserve projection type validity.

Enable BINARY adaptation in filters and projections so comparisons, IN, BETWEEN, cidrmatch, eval if/case, and count(eval(...)) execute against IP and binary columns. Flatten resolved filter conditions before constructing LogicalFilter to avoid nested AND/OR assertion failures.
Update schema-mapping tests, add Rust schema-coercion tests, and add REST coverage for supported field-type scans, IP predicate combinations, and IP/binary project expressions.
Remove the sandbox CI checkout and local publication of SQL artifacts, and run sandbox checks without the Maven-local repository override.

change_request.title: Add Initial Routing and Metadata Groundwork for Virtual Shards

Add tests for enabled and disabled routing, routing partitions, setting validation, range boundaries, override and fallback behavior, invalid helper configurations, and virtual shard ID normalization.
Skip ConsistentSettingsServiceTests when PBKDF2WithHmacSHA512 is unavailable.
Keep side-car segment extraction and transport/state orchestration for override lifecycle management out of scope.

Add regression tests for terminal-sink closure exactly once on failure, non-sink output sources, preservation of the original failure when close throws, and backend-sink double-close prevention for both child-failure/cancellation orderings.

change_request.title: Expose tokio-metrics as datafusion plugin stats

task.task: Expose native Tokio runtime and task-monitor metrics through the DataFusion plugin stats API.

Expose GET /_plugins/datafusion/stats through a REST handler registered when DataFusionService is available. Collect stats afresh on each service call, reject calls before service startup, and return standard REST error responses on failure.

Extract PluginStats and BackendStatsProvider interfaces into sandbox/libs/plugin-stats-spi, keep DataFusion-specific stats classes in the DataFusion plugin, and add its backend-provider scaffold and build dependency.

Add Rust and Java tests for metric packing, layout size and field decoding, service lifecycle checks, REST registration and responses, serialization round-trips, optional components, and deterministic JSON output. Configure jqwik property tests for layout and stats serialization.

change_request.title: [Arrow Flight RPC] Make FlightServerChannel the sole owner of stream lifecycle and buffers
change_request.author: rishabhmaurya

task.task: Make FlightServerChannel the sole owner of Arrow Flight stream buffers and lifecycle, preventing cancellation races, double-close crashes, buffer leaks/use-after-free, and consumer hangs after failed sends.
subtasks: Confine stream-root creation, transfer, serialization, freeing, and all gRPC stream lifecycle calls to the channel’s single-threaded flight executor. Make close() fire once using compareAndSet and enqueue root cleanup without freeing buffers on the caller thread; warn on executor rejection without falling back to inline cleanup.

Introduce sendBatch(response, headerSupplier) to select native or byte serialization inside the channel and build headers before mutating roots. Reduce FlightOutboundHandler to dispatch and outcome reporting. Use a handedOff discipline and channel-owned releaseUnsent helpers to free native batches when back-pressure gating fails, executor submission is rejected, or the channel type is invalid.
Reuse the byte-serialized stream root across batches and retain native and byte stream roots until close(), avoiding per-batch frees that invalidate zero-copy references.

Make completeStream and sendError terminal and idempotent after close, cancellation, or a prior terminal operation. Route batch-send exceptions and non-Exception Throwables through stream failure and channel release before notifying the message listener; preserve secondary error-send failures as suppressed exceptions.
Make close-listener registration and firing atomic with a small leaf mutex, invoke callbacks outside the mutex, and isolate listener failures so remaining listeners still run.

Add regression tests for cancellation during an in-flight send, queued batches rejected after cancellation, concurrent close calls, source-root cleanup on all exit paths, failed handoffs, byte-root reuse, terminal idempotency, listener behavior, and failure-driven stream termination. Run the arrow-flight-rpc check suite and relevant integration tests.

Document the ownership and threading contract in plugins/arrow-flight-rpc/docs/channel-lifecycle-ownership.md, including lifecycle scenarios, asynchronous cleanup, and shutdown-time leaks from rejected or dropped executor tasks.

- Add an absolute row-group index to chunk-relative position map to TreeBitsetSource, SingleCollectorEvaluator, and PredicateOnlyEvaluator; build it from chunk.row_group_indices at evaluator factory sites.
- Thread the map through TreeEvaluator::prefetch and bitmap_tree::prefetch_node, translating every rg_can_match lookup and conservatively avoiding stats pruning when an index or position is unavailable.
- Build tree-mode pruning configuration from the same push_not_down and flatten normalized tree used for resolution so subtree child indices remain aligned.
- Share StatsPruneTree and pruning configuration trees through Arc to avoid deep cloning, updating factory signatures and callers.
- Enable StatsPruneTree in the fuzz harness and add unit regressions for offset indices [2,3,4], unmapped indices, and empty collector bitmap registration in stats-pruned subtrees under OR with Predicate nodes.
- Add end-to-end coverage across single/multiple segments and partitions, including NOT, direct prefetch_rg pruning and offset assertions, empty collector bitmaps, and nested OR normalization and clause-ordering regressions.

change_request.title: Move serial filter initialization from Bootstrap to BootstrapSettings
change_request.author: cwperks

task.task: Initialize the serial filter during Node construction so it applies to both standalone startup and directly instantiated integration-test nodes.
subtasks: Move the reject-all ObjectInputFilter and its installation logic into BootstrapSettings, exposing a public initializeSerialFilter() method. Preserve rejection of resolved classes, UNDECIDED for null serialClass, and debug logging when a process-wide filter is already installed.
Remove serial filter initialization from Bootstrap.setup() and retain Bootstrap.initializeSerialFilter() as a delegate to BootstrapSettings.
In the Node constructor, initialize the filter after pluginsService.updatedSettings() is loaded, gated by bootstrap.serial_filter and preserving its disabled-by-default behavior.
Update BootstrapSerialFilterTests to reference BootstrapSettings.REJECT_ALL_FILTER, preserving coverage of class rejection, null-class handling, and runtime deserialization behavior.
